resources.string: DozyPal counts how many Facebook and Instagram reels you swipe through and shows a small counter on screen. It only listens inside Facebook and Instagram, never reads or saves what is on your screen, and has no internet access.
A sleepy little pal who gets droopier with every reel you scroll.
One step left: turn on DozyPal
DozyPal needs Accessibility access to notice when you swipe to a new reel. Open Accessibility settings, tap DozyPal (it may be under \"Downloaded apps\") and switch it on.
Is the switch greyed out? On Android 13 and newer, open App info, tap the ⋮ menu in the top corner and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Shows a small counter in the corner while you watch reels.
Coming soon: add friends with a code and see who scrolled less today.

DozyPal only counts swipes inside Facebook and Instagram. It never reads messages, never saves what is on your screen, and this version has no internet access at all. Counts stay on your phone and reset every day.
